button.title: Button
button.description: This node is triggered when the button is pressed.

started.title: Usage started
started.description: Triggers when a usage session starts.

stopped.title: Usage stopped
stopped.description: Triggers when a usage session stops.

takeover.title: Usage taken over
takeover.description: Triggers when a usage session is taken over.

no-activity.title: Inactivity timeout reached
no-activity.description: Triggers after the resource has had no recorded activity for the configured duration.

locked.title: Door locked
locked.description: This node is triggered when the door is locked.

unlocked.title: Door unlocked
unlocked.description: This node is triggered when the door is unlocked.

unlatched.title: Door unlatched
unlatched.description: This node is triggered when the door is unlatched.

started.title: Billing calculation started
started.description: This node is triggered when the billing calculation is started. It is mandatory to trigger the 'Add billing items' node afterwards.

received.title: MQTT message received
received.description: This node is triggered when a MQTT message is received.

idle.title: Companion: machine idle
idle.description: Fires when a companion device's machine has been idle for the configured threshold.

active.title: Companion: machine active
active.description: Fires when a companion device's machine returns from idle.

foreground_app_changed.title: Companion: foreground app changed
foreground_app_changed.description: Fires whenever the focused application changes on a companion device. Payload includes appName, bundleId (macOS only), and pid.

usb_device_connected.title: Companion: USB device connected
usb_device_connected.description: Fires when a USB device is connected to a companion device. Payload includes vendorId, productId, manufacturer, product and serialNumber.

usb_device_disconnected.title: Companion: USB device disconnected
usb_device_disconnected.description: Fires when a USB device is disconnected from a companion device. Payload includes vendorId and productId.

changed.title: Variable changed
changed.description: Triggered when a watched flow variable changes value.

wait.title: Wait
wait.description: This node waits for a certain time.

waitForMessage.title: Wait for MQTT message
waitForMessage.description: Waits for the next MQTT message matching the topic filter; forwards {topic, payload}.

failureBehavior.label: On failure
failureBehavior.helpText: Fail flow logs the failure and stops the triggering operation. Continue through failure output logs the failure and sends the original input plus flowError {kind, message} through Failure. Log and continue logs the failure and sends the unchanged input through Output.

if.title: If
if.description: If a value matches a comparison operator, the true-output is triggered, otherwise the false-output.

enum.>=: is greater than or equal to
enum.<=: is less than or equal to

comparisonValueIsPath.label: Comparison value is a payload path

set-payload.title: Set payload
set-payload.description: Set or map keys on the payload using templates.

error.title: Error
error.description: This node throws an error and stops the current flow.

set.title: Set variables
set.description: Stores one or more flow variables. Keys and values support Handlebars templates.

key.label: Key
key.helpText: Identifier for this variable. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.

value.label: Value template
value.helpText: Handlebars template. Reference payload as \{{path.to.field}} and existing variables as \{{variables.KEY}}. Use \{{json payload}} to serialize an object or array as JSON. Plain text without \{{ }} is stored as-is.

scope.label: Scope
scope.helpText: Resource: only this resource sees the value. Global: shared across all resources.

get.title: Get variables
get.description: Reads flow variables and writes them onto the payload at the configured paths.

scope.label: Scope
scope.helpText: Resource: only variables stored on this resource. Global: shared across all resources.

payloadPath.label: Payload path
payloadPath.helpText: Dot path on the payload where the value will be written, e.g. user.email.

sendRequest.title: Send HTTP request
sendRequest.description: This node sends a HTTP request.

timeoutSeconds.label: Response timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.helpText: Maximum time to wait for the controller response. Leave empty to wait without a node-specific timeout.

completionBehavior.label: Completion
completionBehavior.helpText: Dispatch only continues after the HTTP request is initiated. Wait for response waits for the controller response.

failureBehavior.label: On failure
failureBehavior.helpText: Fail flow logs the failure and stops the triggering operation. Continue through failure output logs the failure and sends the original input plus flowError {kind, message} through Failure. Log and continue logs the failure and sends the unchanged input through Output.

sendMessage.title: Send MQTT message
sendMessage.description: This node sends a MQTT message.

completionBehavior.label: Completion
completionBehavior.helpText: Dispatch continues after MQTT accepts the publish call. Acknowledged waits for the broker publish callback.

acknowledgementTimeoutSeconds.label: Acknowledgement timeout (seconds)
acknowledgementTimeoutSeconds.helpText: Maximum time to wait for the MQTT publish acknowledgement. Leave empty to use the integration default.

failureBehavior.label: On failure
failureBehavior.helpText: Fail flow logs the failure and stops the triggering operation. Continue through failure output logs the failure and sends the original input plus flowError {kind, message} through Failure. Log and continue logs the failure and sends the unchanged input through Output.

lock-pc.title: Lock PC
lock-pc.description: Locks the screen on a registered companion device.

unlock-pc.title: Unlock PC
unlock-pc.description: Unlocks the screen on a registered companion device.

operating.title: Record operation started
operating.description: Records that the resource began operating at the current server time.

idle.title: Record operation stopped
idle.description: Records that the resource stopped operating at the current server time.

end-session.title: End active session
end-session.description: Ends the current usage session, optionally with a note.

failureBehavior.label: On failure
failureBehavior.helpText: Fail flow logs the failure and stops the triggering operation. Continue through failure output logs the failure and sends the original input plus flowError {kind, message} through Failure. Log and continue logs the failure and sends the unchanged input through Output.

set-additional-items.title: Add billing item
set-additional-items.description: With this node you can add an additional item to the billing.

track-activity.title: Record activity
track-activity.description: Records activity for this resource at the current server time.

heartbeat.title: Send health heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Marks the resource healthy when this node fires. If no heartbeat arrives within the configured timeout the resource is automatically marked unhealthy.

set.title: Set health state
set.description: Sets the resource health state. Static config values can be overridden by payload fields (health.identifier, health.status, health.reason).
